```{r}
library(ariadne)
library(curatedMetagenomicData)
library(mia)
library(miaViz)
```

## Functional module analysis

```{r}
# Load gene family experiment
genes <- curatedMetagenomicData(
    "SankaranarayananK_2015.gene_families", dryrun = FALSE
)

genes <- genes[[1]]

# Process experiment
genes <- processGeneFamilies(genes)

# Print experiment
genes
```

```{r}
tax2uniref <- rowData(genes)[c("taxname", "uniref90")] |>
    data.frame(row.names = NULL)

head(tax2uniref)
```

```{r}
graph <- ariadne()

searchPath(graph, uniref90 ~ gmm, k = 3)
```

```{r}
# Weave bindings between taxa and GMMs
tax2gmm <- weaveComplex(graph, taxname ~ gmm, k = 2, init = tax2uniref)

# Print some results
head(tax2gmm)
```

```{r}
tse <- curatedMetagenomicData(
    "SankaranarayananK_2015.relative_abundance",
    rownames = "long",
    dryrun = FALSE
)

tse <- tse[[1]]

tse
```

```{r}
rowData(tse)$taxname <- sub("^.*(g__.+)\\|(s__.+)$", "\\1.\\2", rownames(tse))

rowData(tse) <- appendModules(rowData(tse), tax2gmm, by = "taxname", as = "names")

tse
```


```{r}
altExp(tse, "modules") <- agglomerateByModule(
    tse, by = 1, group = unique(tax2gmm$gmm.name)
)

top.mods <- altExp(tse, "modules") |>
    getTop(assay.type = "relative_abundance")
```

```{r}
tse <- swapAltExp(
    tse,
    name = "modules",
    saved = "features",
    withColData = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
plotAbundance(
    tse[top.mods, ],
    assay.type = "relative_abundance",
    as.relative = TRUE,
    order.col.by = "disease",
    col.var = "disease"
)
```

```{r}
plotAbundanceDensity(
    tse,
    assay.type = "relative_abundance",
    n = 5,
    layout = "density",
    colour.by = "disease"
)
```
